description: Expression-language vectors, run by cairn-ui src/lib/expr/expr.test.ts and cairn tests/unit/test_expr_vectors.py. Floats compare with relative tolerance 1e-12; {"$f": "nan"|"inf"|"-inf"} encodes non-finite floats anywhere. A case has expr or template, a ctx name, and either expected (+ type, warnings, plan, deps) or error {message, span}. An error message must match exactly. Contexts: series {steps, values, wall?}, stats {metric: {reducer: value}}, config/summary by flattened key, run fields.
